```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot)
install.packages("palmerpenguins")
install.packages("plotly")
install.packages("ggplot")
penguins <- penguins
```

## Row 1

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = bill_len)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
